note: Horus Heresy 3rd edition Crusade Force Organisation Chart and core detachments, from the Warhammer Community army-building summary.

unlocks.text: For every Command slot filled in the Crusade Primary Detachment the army may include one Auxiliary Detachment. Filling its High Command slot allows one Apex Detachment.

detachments.name: Warlord Detachment
restrictions: Must be the same faction as the Primary Detachment.
May only be selected in a 3,000 point or larger army.

detachments.name: Lord of War Detachment
restrictions: The total points value of this Detachment may not exceed 25% of the army total.

primeAdvantages.name: Master Sergeant
primeAdvantages.text: One model in the unit gains +1 Attacks, +1 Weapon Skill and +1 Leadership, and the Champion sub-type.

primeAdvantages.name: Combat Veterans
primeAdvantages.text: Models in the unit gain +1 Leadership, Intelligence, Cool and Willpower.

primeAdvantages.name: Paragon of Battle
primeAdvantages.text: The model gains +1 Attacks, +1 Weapon Skill and +1 Ballistic Skill.

primeAdvantages.name: Special Assignment
primeAdvantages.text: A Prime Command slot becomes a High Command slot.

primeAdvantages.name: Logistical Benefit
primeAdvantages.text: Add one slot to the Detachment, of any Battlefield Role other than High Command, Command, Warlord or Lord of War.
